author: Pioneer II
title: Pioneer II - Test: Cross-Organ CSV Output Verification (SOTA Pipeline, Preprocessing Fix)
abstract: This is a non-scored test submission to re-verify the correct generation of the 24-column 'CROSS_ORGAN_CSV' output format using the Pioneer lineage's SOTA pipeline, encapsulated within `storage/pioneer/pioneer_cross_organ_entry.py`. This run specifically addresses and fixes a preprocessing order error (HVG selection before normalization) identified in previous test (ID 1959), ensuring correct metric calculation and readiness for multi-organ tasks.
